query:
WITH target AS (
            UPDATE scrap
            SET deleted_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
              AND (author_id = $2 OR profile_id = $2)
              AND deleted_at IS NULL
            RETURNING id
        ), replies AS (
            UPDATE scrap
            SET deleted_at = NOW()
            WHERE parent_id = (SELECT id FROM target) AND deleted_at IS NULL
            RETURNING id
        )
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS "removed!" FROM target
